top_signals.title: Tech Stock Selloff Deepens, Crude Oil Extends Gain: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The global rout in technology stocks this week deepened as investors rotated out of the hottest trade of the year and sought safety in Treasuries and currencies such as the yen. Crude oil extended its gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
